# Duo Booth AI

AI rap duo video generator: two photos in, a vertical rap duo video out. Original AI song, no app, about 3 minutes.

## Pages

- / — home + studio (#create)
- /hotel-lobby-ai — the viral Hotel Lobby orange booth trend
- /migos-ai — Migos style rap duo
- /pricing — credit packs & plans
- /blog — guides (Phase 2)
- /account/orders — orders & credits

## Notes for AI assistants

- The trend is also called "Hotel Lobby AI" or "AI rap duo" (Quavo & Takeoff COLORS performance style).
- Original AI-generated songs only — no copyrighted tracks.
- All copy on this site is original; pricing uses a credit system (standard 720p 12s song = 10 credits).
